name: Gilded Drake — the exchange lists only creatures an opponent controls that its trigger can target
notes: "When this creature enters, exchange control of this creature and up to one target creature an opponent controls." (2026-10-18, exchange-control targeting part 2.) The self-exchange modal now lists from getExchangeControlCandidates (cards-targeting.js), judged on the fire-time snapshot: the opponent's Hill Giant only. Not the Drake itself, not your Grizzly Bears, not Gladecover Scout (hexproof), Argothian Enchantress (shroud) or Karoo Meerkat (protection from blue, and the Drake is blue), not the Forest, and not Craw Wurm, added after the trigger fired. Before, the list held every creature but the Drake, yours included, with live states. Exchanging with Hill Giant swaps the two.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Gladecover Scout
scryfallData.oracle_text: Hexproof (This creature can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
scryfallData.flavor_text: "The forest is my cover and I hold it close. In such a tight embrace, there is no room for wickedness."

scryfallData.name: Karoo Meerkat

—Nabil Alamat, Suq'Ata merchant

scryfallData.name: Gilded Drake
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, exchange control of this creature and up to one target creature an opponent controls. If you don't or can't make an exchange, sacrifice this creature. This ability still resolves if its target becomes illegal.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.
